comment: Reference adapter for Claude Code on macOS. Identical to claude-code.example.json except scheduled-maint: macOS schedules via launchd LaunchAgents (cli.py setup install-memory-launchd), not crontab. The ~/.claude layout (skills/, settings.json) is the same as on Linux, so the other verify commands are unchanged. Copy to ~/.config/nervepack/adapter.json (per-machine; not committed).
paths_note: OPTIONAL, and optional per key. Omit the block, or any single key, and nervepack uses its built-in ~/.claude/... default for whatever is missing -- every manifest written before #300 has no paths block and keeps working unchanged. The matching environment variable (CLAUDE_SETTINGS / NP_SKILLS_DST / CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR) still wins over both. A relative value is ignored and reported by the doctor.
